T: Raised in Kansas. Fed in Kansas.
D: A young man raised on a Kansas farm learns he came from the dying planet Krypton.
P: Serve the mains when Clark comes home to Martha on the farm.
S: young Clark pushing the bus out of the river

Corn kernels mixed with flour, egg, spring onion and paprika, fried in spoonfuls until golden, with a sour cream and chive dip. Mix a drained can of corn with 100g flour, 2 eggs, sliced spring onions and a pinch of paprika. Fry spoonfuls in a little oil until golden on both sides. Stir chopped chives through sour cream for the dip and serve the fritters warm.
Clark working on the fishing boat
Flathead pieces dusted in flour and paprika, fried at 180C until crisp, with lemon and tartare sauce.
the roadside bar where Clark works for a while

Buttermilk chicken tenders fried crisp and tossed in buttery hot sauce, with celery sticks and a cool blue cheese dip. Soak 800g chicken tenderloins in 250ml buttermilk with salt for 1 hour. Toss in 150g plain flour mixed with 1 tsp paprika and 1 tsp garlic powder, and fry at 180C for 5 minutes until golden. Melt 60g butter with 120ml hot sauce and toss the chicken through. Mix 80g crumbled blue cheese with 100g sour cream and 2 tbsp mayo. Serve with celery sticks.
M: Beef chuck browned and braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrot, celery and stock, potatoes added for the last hour.
Lois Lane at the Daily Planet

Triple-decker toasted club of roast chicken, crisp bacon, avocado, tomato, lettuce and mayo, cut into triangles with a pickle and chips. Fry 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Toast 12 slices of white bread. Slice 400g roast chicken breast, 2 tomatoes and 1 avocado. Spread 8 slices of toast with mayo. Build each sandwich: toast, lettuce, chicken and tomato, then toast, bacon and avocado, then a final slice. Hold with 4 toothpicks, cut into 4 triangles and serve with pickles and potato chips.
W: on Krypton the symbol means hope

Apples cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, with ice cream and a pastry S. Cook 6 sliced green apples with 50g butter, 100g brown sugar and a teaspoon of cinnamon until just soft, then cool. Line a pie dish with shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice top. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes and serve warm with ice cream.
K: a hot afternoon on the Kansas farm

Fresh lemon juice and strawberries muddled with basil and sugar syrup, topped with cold water in a big jug of ice. Simmer 150g caster sugar and 150ml water until dissolved, then cool. Blend 250g hulled strawberries with the syrup and strain. In a big jug, bruise a handful of basil leaves, then add the strawberry syrup, 200ml fresh lemon juice and 1L cold water. Stir, add lots of ice and sliced strawberries and lemons, and serve in tall glasses with a basil leaf on top.

s.note: Clark working on the fishing boat
s.how: Cut 500g flathead into bite-sized pieces and dust in flour mixed with smoked paprika and salt. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until crisp. Drain on paper and serve with lemon wedges and tartare sauce, like a meal on the deck of a trawler.

m.how: Brown a 1.5kg piece of beef chuck all over. Add a sliced onion, 3 carrots, 2 celery sticks and 500ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours, adding 800g potatoes for the last hour. Slice and serve with the juices.
